title: Velázquez
objective: After this level you can explain why Las Meninas still puzzles viewers.
summary: Las Meninas (1656) shows the young infanta, her maids of honor and Velázquez at a huge hidden canvas. A mirror reflects the king and queen, so what is he painting, and where are you standing?

cards.headline: Centuries later, nobody agrees what this painting is of.
cards.body: It's Las Meninas, painted in 1656 by Diego Velázquez, painter to the king of Spain. It looks like a simple scene at court. Then you notice the mirror.

cards.headline: A princess and her court
cards.body: At the center stands the five-year-old Infanta Margarita Teresa, the king's daughter. Her maids of honor, the meninas, attend her. Nearby are two people with dwarfism and a big dog lying on the floor. It could be an ordinary afternoon in the palace. Almost.

cards.headline: The painter is in the painting
cards.body: From 1623 Velázquez worked for King Philip IV, the only painter allowed to paint the king. In Las Meninas he put himself in the scene: at the left, brush in hand, in front of a huge canvas. We see only its back. Whatever he's painting, we're not allowed to look.

cards.fact: The mirror shows the king and queen.
cards.context: On the back wall, a small mirror reflects King Philip IV and Queen Mariana. So where are they? One reading says they stand where you stand, and everyone has just noticed them. Another says the mirror shows the hidden canvas. The painting leaves it open, which is why it's often called a painting about painting.

cards.headline: Las Meninas: puzzled
learned: Las Meninas (1656) centers on the young infanta and her maids
Velázquez, the king's painter, painted himself at a hidden canvas
A mirror reflects King Philip IV and Queen Mariana
What he's painting, and where you stand, stay open questions

questions.prompt: At the center of Las Meninas stands _____.

options.label: King Philip IV on his throne
options.rationale: He appears only in the mirror.

questions.explanation: The five-year-old infanta stands at the center, surrounded by her maids of honor.

questions.prompt: In Las Meninas, match each figure or detail with what it is or shows.

pairs.right: King Philip IV and Queen Mariana

questions.explanation: Infanta Margarita Teresa is the king's daughter, the meninas are her maids of honor, Velázquez stands brush in hand, and the mirror reflects King Philip IV and Queen Mariana.

questions.prompt: Like Rembrandt, Velázquez painted himself. How does he appear in Las Meninas?

options.label: As an old man, in thick paint
At work, brush in hand, before a huge canvas
As a reflection in the back mirror
options.rationale: The mirror shows the king and queen.

options.label: Half in shadow, as a young man at 22
